name: Ip2_FrictMat_FrictMat_CapillaryMindlinPhysDelaunay
description: Variant of Ip2_(matType)_(matType)_(iPhysType) to be used with CapillarityEngine.

attributes.name: computeDefault
attributes.description: bool to assign the default value of computeBridge.

attributes.name: gamma
attributes.description: Surface energy parameter [J/m^2] per each unit contact surface, to derive DMT formulation from HM

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Coefficient to determine the plastic bending moment

attributes.name: krot
attributes.description: Rotational stiffness for moment contact law

attributes.name: ktwist
attributes.description: Torsional stiffness for moment contact law

attributes.name: vn
attributes.description: Impact velocity corresponding to the en value to calculate the dissipative constant $An$ used in the viscous damping model of (Mueller2011).

attributes.name: frictAngle
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining how to compute the friction angle of an interaction. If None, minimum value is used.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
